i_do_intro.current_content: Ocho demos de S43 calculan el contrato de contenedores (CP-N4-A): cada una deriva evidencia de entradas, no imprime un veredicto hardcodeado.
i_do_intro.attack: Several demos derive verdicts from booleans/strings supplied by the fixture rather than from Docker/runtime evidence; therefore 'calculan el contrato' is overstated.
i_do_intro.defense: The demos do compute predicates rather than printing a literal PASS, so they have value as conceptual preflight.
i_do_intro.improved_content: Ocho demos empiezan con un predictor Python para hacer explícita la regla y después ejecutan la operación equivalente con Docker/Compose. El veredicto final se deriva del build, inspect, health request, signal or store operation—not from a boolean that says the control already passed.

i_do.current_content: Demo Dockerfile/layers/cache: `dockerfile_steps`/logical dependency digest and cache status from a Python list + lock string.
i_do.improved_content: I Do: build a valid fixture image with Docker BuildKit, show first build, change only src, show dependency layer CACHED, then run a clean/no-cache build and record real image/dependency evidence. Explain which observation is cache efficiency and which is reproducibility.

i_do.current_content: Demo base/non-root/size: supplied base/uid/capabilities/runtime_mb values satisfy a Python predicate.
i_do.improved_content: I Do: build the fixture, run it, use `docker inspect` and `id -u`, inspect effective capabilities and image size, and compare the base reference to an exact digest. Show a named non-root user as a valid case.

i_do.current_content: Demo secrets/volumes: layer strings are scanned only for SECRET=/PASSWORD= and `runtime_only` is inferred from no match.
i_do.improved_content: I Do: add `.dockerignore`; seed a synthetic secret that would leak through COPY/ARG; show the bad image/history; repair with Compose secret mount; start service, prove secret exists at runtime but not image/history; rotate without rebuild; inspect durable/ephemeral mounts.

i_do.current_content: Demo health/SIGTERM: `health_status(ready,live)` and `on_sigterm(drains=True, grace=30)` simulate results.
i_do.improved_content: I Do: run service+DB, curl readiness/liveness, stop DB to observe readiness failure, restore it, start controlled in-flight work, send SIGTERM/docker stop, and measure drain/exit against the lab grace configuration.

we_do.current_content: Repair an inverted predicate so fields `lock_copied_before_source`, `dependency_layer_reused`, `source_change_rebuilds==1`, `digest_stable` yield `S43-T1-A PASS`.
we_do.improved_content: Guided: learner predicts which Dockerfile instruction will be cached, runs two builds, identifies `CACHED` dependency step in BuildKit output, and records it. Instructor supplies commands but not the observation.
Given two real Dockerfiles, learner runs builds after src-only change and diagnoses cache order from build output; a missing build log becomes evidence-missing, not a fabricated digest field.

we_do.current_content: Parse Dockerfile text; `COPY requirements` before `COPY src` → CONTINUE; None → INSPECT.
we_do.improved_content: Keep text preflight, but add transfer: run the selected Dockerfile. Use a syntactically valid base reference; prove it builds. Text order alone is not the final acceptance.

we_do.current_content: Repair base_pinned + uid>=1000 + no capabilities + runtime<=max predicate.
we_do.improved_content: Guided runtime inspection: start known good image, extract actual UID/caps/size and fill the evidence table from commands; validate positive numeric domains.
Learner receives two built images/Compose variants and uses inspect/runtime commands to decide; include a non-root UID below 1000 to force distinction between root property and course policy.

we_do.current_content: Parse `USER`/`FROM`; numeric UID>=1000 and any `@sha256:` substring count as good.
we_do.improved_content: Do not parse USER as proof. Build/run and inspect actual user; accept valid named users. Validate exact 64-hex digest or inspect image metadata. Add regressions for `USER appuser` and `@sha256:abc`.

we_do.current_content: Repair boolean predicate: no baked secret + runtime_secret + config + db durable + cache ephemeral.
we_do.improved_content: Guided Compose secret exercise: learner grants a synthetic secret only to API and verifies access/no access across services, then inspects image/history.
Use a bad build context containing `.env` and a bad ephemeral DB volume; learner repairs `.dockerignore`/Compose volumes and demonstrates data survives cache recreation/redeploy.

we_do.current_content: Inspect synthetic layer strings for SECRET=/PASSWORD= and volume sets; output CONTINUE/REMOVE/CLASSIFY.
we_do.improved_content: Seed synthetic TOKEN/API_KEY plus `.env`; use real history/image scan and Compose secret grant. Test secret rotation without rebuild. Layer-string search remains a warm-up, not a gate.
Guided terminal steps: curl ready/live, stop DB, curl again, restore DB, send SIGTERM; learner fills observed statuses/timestamps instead of booleans.
Provide two container configurations; learner runs failure injection and explains whether failure is readiness, liveness or termination. Missing grace config is diagnosed from Compose/Docker config.

we_do.current_content: Parse synthetic probe/SIGTERM logs and route CONTINUE/DRAIN/DIAGNOSE.
we_do.improved_content: Keep log interpretation as transfer, but logs must come from the learner's actual stopped container; require causal timestamps and exit status so a fabricated log cannot satisfy the gate.

validation.reason: Every subtopic needs an authentic Docker/runtime bridge before final capstone.
